name: Human skin (MERSCOPE)
description: MERFISH of normal adult human skin on a 499-gene panel: 3,003 cells segmented with Baysor, with their outlines, from a spatial census of skin across 15 anatomic sites; opens on COL1A1 (dermal fibroblasts).

source.citation: Restrepo P et al. (2026) A single-cell spatial census of human skin anatomy. Nature Genetics. doi:10.1038/s41588-026-02552-8
